title: Rav Yehudah of Daaskarta or Daskarta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman finds him always raising objections to Rava in Yevamot 87, Nazir 35, Sotah 6 and 25, and Niddah 35 and 39; apparently he was one of Rava’s leading students. In [Nazir 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.52a.1) he offers a proof concerning Rava’s question. In [Shabbat 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.93a.6-7) he disputes Rav Zevid’s report in Rava’s name. In [Gittin 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.28b.2-3) Rav Ada bar Matna objects to Rava; Rav Yehudah of Daskarta answers, “A wineskin is different.” Rav Mesharshiya objects: “Does your guarantor need a guarantor?” Rava then gives a different answer, etc.
Hyman concludes that he was senior to Rav Papa: in Niddah 39 ([compare Niddah 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.39a.16)) Rav Papa says, “I recited the teaching before Rav Yehudah of Daskarta.”[^3]

notes.text: The unmarked folios remain without added a/b designations. His rank as a leading student and seniority to Rav Papa are Hyman’s inferences.

The consulted Gittin 28b explicitly has Rav Ada bar Matna objecting to Rava, Rav Yehudah of Daskarta answering about a wineskin, Rav Mesharshiya objecting and Rava then answering. Hyman’s “always” assertion, leading-student inference and seniority to Rav Papa remain his judgments. Unmarked supplied folios receive no invented side.

The consulted Nazir and Shabbat spell the epithet Disqarta, alongside Hyman’s Daaskarta or Daskarta. Niddah records Rav Papa presenting the teaching before him. Hyman draws a conclusion about seniority.
